mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the remote core was most worthwhile: seeing the folded outline again connected the careful transfer to the discovery, while keeping the two samples separate.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the membrane specimen was the least engaging passage; it completed the goal without describing how the specimen was secured.

surprise.text: I was mildly surprised that simply placing the membrane at the locker completed its goal, with no further securing step.

arbitrary.text: The membrane placement had a clear purpose, but the lack of a securing detail made its immediate completion feel a little abrupt.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see what the laboratories learn from the preserved cores, though this chapter's mostly sequential transfer offered few meaningful decisions.
